idea-plugin.name: Copy Text Anywhere
idea-plugin.description:
Copy Text Anywhere adds a "Copy Text" option to all right-click context menus across the IDE.

Features:

  • Adds "Copy Text" to editor context menus - copy selected text or current line
  • Adds "Copy Text" to project view, structure view, and console popups
  • Adds "Copy Text" to diff viewer and VCS Log (git history) context menus
  • Adds "Copy Text" to VCS Log changed files list and file history context menus
  • Adds "Copy Text" to commit dialog context menus
  • Works with text fields, labels, tables, trees, lists, and many more components

Simply right-click anywhere text is displayed and select "Copy Text" to copy it to your clipboard!

Copy Text Anywhere（复制文本到任意位置）是一款 IntelliJ IDEA 插件，

在 IDE 几乎所有右键菜单中添加「复制文本」选项，支持编辑区、项目视图、控制台、差异查看器、Git 提交对话框、VCS 日志等多种场景。
